name: Bing Li
title: Associate Professor
department: Automotive Engineering; Clemson University International Center for Automotive Research
fitReason: AutoAI studies learned perception and embodied systems, including foundation-model domain adaptation that enables simulation-trained driving policies to execute on actual vehicles. This offers a concrete software/robot-learning project fit beyond offline scene understanding.

physicalEvidence.summary: Sim2Real Diffusion, revised October 2025, executes behavioral-cloning policies on actual Nigel indoor and Hunter outdoor vehicles. A conditional latent-diffusion adapter converts camera frames toward the training-domain appearance. Ten-trial comparisons report 90 percent success for Nigel and straight-path Hunter. Author-deposited software metadata explicitly identifies Li as a supervisor, supporting direct group attribution.

shortVisit.summary: The live lab homepage recruits a fully funded PhD student, not an external summer researcher. Its people page records research interns, predominantly identified as local undergraduates, without a current external-master’s invitation. No summer 2027 route verified.

unknowns: The driving study is low-speed, with roughly 5–7 image inferences per second on tested local/edge hardware. Its 40 percent domain-gap figure is an image-style metric, not a 40 percent driving-success improvement. This is diffusion-assisted perception feeding behavioral cloning, not a general VLA manipulation policy.

The journal issue is dated 2026, but the inspected hardware manuscript is October 2025. The LLM digital-twin paper concerns scenario editing in simulation and is not a separate physical LLM-control demonstration.

The lab is at CU-ICAR in Greenville. Creative Inquiry is a credit-bearing local course; it does not establish eligibility for an eight-week external visit. Clemson visitor appointment and funding rules need separate confirmation.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
